termsAndConditions.title: Terms of Use
termsAndConditions.intro: These terms apply to your use of this site. Please read them before using it.

sections.title: Services
sections.content: Nikola Popovic offers automation, tool configuration and website services, along with related consultations, notably for private clinics. The site lets you book a free Front Desk Review call.

sections.title: Booking
items: A clinic or business can book one free Review, unless otherwise agreed.
We may cancel or move a call if something unexpected comes up, or refuse a booking in case of abuse.

sections.title: No legal advice
sections.content: The Review and our services provide facts and technical recommendations. They are neither legal advice nor a compliance opinion. You remain responsible for your legal and professional obligations.

sections.title: Your commitments
sections.content: By using the site, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate information.
Not send any patient information through our forms.
Not use the site for illegal purposes.
Respect our intellectual property rights.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.content: The site is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, we aren't liable for:
items: Indirect damages arising from your use of the site.
Errors, delays or interruptions of the site.

sections.title: Age
sections.content: This site is for people 18 and older.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of Quebec and the laws of Canada that apply there.

sections.title: Changes
sections.content: We may update these terms. Changes apply as soon as they're posted on this page.

contactInfo.title: Contact us
contactInfo.content: For any question about these terms, write to us at {{email}}.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what personal information this site collects, why, who receives it and what your rights are. The site is for clinic owners and businesses, not patients. Please don't enter any patient information in our forms.

sections.title: Person in charge of personal information
sections.content: Nikola Popovic is the person in charge of protecting personal information. You can reach him at admin@nikolapopovic.dev.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.content: You give us this information when you fill out the form or book a call:
items: Your contact details: first name, last name, email and phone.
Your clinic or business: name, website, annual revenue and team size.
Your needs: the topics you pick and what you write in the free-text field.
The time of the call you book.
Technical details sent with the form: language, page address and browser type.

sections.title: Why we use it
items: Answer your request, prepare your Review and manage your call.
Send you messages related to your request.
Protect the form against spam.
Measure the site and our ads, only if you accepted the related cookies.

sections.title: Automated decision
sections.content: The booking calendar appears based on the annual revenue you enter: it doesn't appear below $100,000. You then get a reply by email. You can write to us to learn the reasons for this result, correct your information or ask a person to review your request.

sections.title: Providers that receive your information
sections.content: We don't sell your information. We only share it with the providers needed to run the site and follow up on your request:
items: n8n, on our self-hosted server: receives the form and keeps it in a submissions table.
LeadConnector (GoHighLevel, United States): contact management and call booking.
ClickUp (United States): tracking your request.
Slack (United States): internal notice with a summary of your request.
Google (United States): emails related to your request.
Cloudflare (United States): network, form security and cookie-free site performance measurement.
GitHub Pages (United States): site hosting, which may process your IP address.
Senja (outside Canada): displaying testimonials, which may process your IP address when you visit.
PostHog (United States): statistics, only if you accept analytics cookies.
Meta (United States): ad measurement, only if you accept marketing cookies.

sections.title: Information held outside Quebec
sections.content: Several of these providers are located outside Quebec, so your information may be stored there or pass through there. To ask about a specific provider, write to us.

sections.title: Cookies and statistics
sections.content: No analytics or marketing cookie is turned on without your agreement. You can change your choice anytime with the Cookie Settings link at the bottom of the page.
items: Necessary: remember your language and cookie choices.
Analytics (PostHog): count page views and form steps. What you type isn't sent, and sessions aren't recorded.
Marketing (Meta Pixel): measure our ads. If you accept them and fill out the form, your email, phone and first name may be sent to Meta in hashed form.

sections.title: Retention
sections.content: We keep your information for up to 3 years after our last exchange, unless you ask us to delete it sooner or the law requires us to keep it longer. It is then deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You can write to us to:
items: Access your personal information or have it corrected.
Withdraw your consent or ask us to delete your information.
Get your information in a structured format.
File a complaint. If you aren't satisfied with our answer, you can contact Quebec's Commission d'accès à l'information.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: We limit access to your information to the people and providers who need it. No system is 100% secure. If a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious injury, we'll notify you as the law requires.

sections.title: Minors
sections.content: This site is for adults. We don't knowingly collect information about people under 18.

sections.title: Changes
sections.content: We'll post any update on this page with its new date.

contactInfo.title: Contact us
contactInfo.content: For any question about this policy, write to us at {{email}}.
